title: Nimbus decision log entry
description: One append-only row of the decision log (PRD v5.0 FR-20): who decided, with which inputs, producing which output, under which lease version. who names the deciding party: cloud, edge, or rule for decisions; requester for the human's own words and answers, which enter the same log so a task's timeline can be replayed end to end. lease_version is null when no lease existed yet (e.g. the initial request).

who.description: Deciding party (FR-20: cloud, edge or rule); requester rows carry the human's request and answers.

inputs.description: What the decision was based on (request text, robot status, map state, ...).

output.description: What was decided (question asked, lease issued, event handled, ...).

lease_version.description: Lease version in force, or null before any lease exists.

timestamp.description: When the decision was recorded (wall-clock, ISO 8601).

task_id.description: Task the decision belongs to; GET /tasks/{id}/timeline returns all rows for one task.
